answer: Witnessed Irreversible Actuator Events. Each identity must periodically command a physical actuator (valve, servo) whose motion is filmed by an independent camera and hash-timestamped into a public vault. A sybil cluster cannot fake these because one operator physically cannot actuate many separated devices simultaneously; forging footage requires colluding camera hardware. Each enrolled device costs the attacker a distinct walnut-sized actuator plus camera, and every missed event burns that identity's haven of accumulated event history, forcing re-enrollment from scratch.
